verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes PDF.js as the reader engine for the dashboard and email-linked reader, defining implementation-relevant reader behavior and scope.
Login gating and verified PDF-download access concern NFT-holder access control rather than reader navigation.
The client explicitly changes the rendered book-view width by 25%, an implementation-relevant reader UI behavior that leaves no stale prior attribute.
This is the first retained concrete navigation failure and distinguishes working keyboard navigation from cursor controls that became unusable after fading.
The client reports a concrete post-fix test and accepts the permanently visible reader navigation controls as working.
